text:
Sidney Crosby is 39, Pittsburgh was 7-13-2 after Saturday, and the trade rumors have started writing themselves. The Hockey News, Yahoo Sports and NHL Trade Rumors have all floated landing spots, Montreal among them. His agent, Pat Brisson, said on Sportsnet 590 The FAN this week that Crosby wants to stay a Penguin, and he holds a full no-movement clause. That should settle more than it will.

On the ice, the slow start looks more like bad luck than decline. He has 15 points in 23 games, but the Penguins have scored 4.8 fewer goals than their chances deserved with him on, and he has six goals on 7.9 expected. Our range for his scoring rate runs from 2.4 to 3.3 points per 60, above his current 2.0 and above the league's 2.1.

Evolving-Hockey saw the same gap last season, 2.9 expected wins against 1.2 actual, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had his shot assists in the 99th percentile. The playmaking hasn't left. Watch whether the finishing around him catches up before the rest of the season is spent on rumors.
